pulse.text: The queue was jammed, not broken — nothing moved for 14 hours because every window already had a pull request open, and the safety rule skips those. Cleared at 2:53 PM: six dead pull requests closed, W52 written and fired. By 3:09 PM the builder had rebuilt all three waiting branches and testing is under way. Nothing merged this pass — two branches passed every test but now collide with the main line, and one has a real failure being read from its log. The 275-deliverable catalog import is waiting on one thing only: copying the catalog files into the repository from the Mac.
